entry.title: New: Resolution 121 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI OFFICE OF RESEARCH SERVICES

Funds in the amount of $25,000 from the Department of Research and Development would be used to conduct GoFarm Hawai‘i, the university’s comprehensive agricultural education program.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 121-25 & GOEAC-40 - 5/7/25
